_readme: Invented notes for checking the LLM (PROJECT-PLAN MM-501). No real student notes. None of them contains a crisis phrase, because crisis notes never reach the model. expected_themes only lists the clear themes, so the script reports theme overlap, not exact match.

notes.text: Exam week is here and I have three finals in four days.
Slept only three hours again, can't focus in class.
Had lunch with my friends today and laughed a lot.
Nothing special today, just went to class and came home.
Rent is due and my allowance has not arrived yet, a bit stressed.
Finished my assignment early and went for a long walk.
I feel alone in this group project, nobody replies to my messages.
Got a cold and a headache, stayed in bed all day.
Hard to get started on my thesis, I keep putting it off.
Talked things through with my sister and feel much lighter.
Minggu ujian mulai, tugas numpuk banget.
Begadang lagi semalam, ngantuk parah di kelas.
Makan siang bareng teman-teman, seru banget hari ini.
Hari ini biasa aja, kuliah terus pulang.
Uang kos belum bayar dan kiriman belum masuk, agak pusing.
Tugas kelompok selesai lebih cepat, lanjut jalan sore.
Rasanya sendirian terus, nggak ada yang ngajak ngobrol.
Lagi demam dan pusing, seharian cuma tiduran.
Males banget mulai skripsi, nunda terus dari kemarin.
Ngobrol sama kakak bikin hati lebih tenang.
